data.narrative:
Sorcerer is a seed-stage company in Climate & Energy founded by Austin Tindle, Maxmillion McLaughlin, and Alessandro Vecchi. The company has raised $3.9M to date. The Climate & Energy sector includes one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers such as Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix, though none provide sufficiently tight stage or valuation-tier matches for robust peer median analysis.

Given data constraints, the valuation relies on stage-progression methodology. Using the $3.9M total raised as a proxy base value, a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of $9.75M. This represents the single applicable triangulation anchor for the analysis.

The supported valuation range is $8M to $11M, with a median point of $10M. This range reflects inherent uncertainty: peer-median analysis was not feasible due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow Climate & Energy frontier-tech universe. Key sensitivities include timing to next financing round, capital efficiency relative to sector norms, and whether follow-on funding multiples compress or expand given macro conditions. A wider comp search spanning related deep-tech verticals or extension of observation period for emerging Climate & Energy seed rounds would materially strengthen conviction.
